name: Input Buffer
description: Remembers clicks that come a few frames early and fires them when you can act. Auto safe mode included.

buffer-frames.name: Buffer window (frames)
buffer-frames.description: How many frames an early click is remembered until you can act on it. 0 disables buffering.

auto-safe-mode.name: Auto Safe Mode
auto-safe-mode.description: Don't save progress or completions while the buffer is on. Recommended.
